items.title: Men Die Younger, Yet Men’s Health Remains Neglected: Lancet Series
items.summary: The Lancet Series finds men face higher mortality and unequal access to health care, with poverty and insecure work worsening outcomes. Researchers say policy neglect has left room for the manosphere to profit from men’s insecurities. The post Men Die Younger, Yet Men’s Health Remains Neglected: Lancet Series appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: APHM Wants Review Of MediAsas’ RM100,000 Annual Limit
items.summary: APHM calls for a review of MediAsas’s RM100,000 annual coverage limit to ensure it meets patients’ needs. The suggestion for the Base MHIT comes amid uncertainty over potential withdrawals or changes to individual medical insurance products from Jan 2027. items.title: Insurers Faced Losses On Some Medical Plans After Years Without Repricing: BNM
items.summary: Bank Negara tells the PAC that extending protection against MHIT repricing hikes above 10% to all policyholders is unsustainable because some insurers incurred losses due to Covid without premium increases. These interim measures are set to end next month. The post Insurers Faced Losses On Some Medical Plans After Years Without Repricing: BNM appeared first on CodeBlue .

items.title: MediAsas: Affordable Assurance Means Little Without Affordable Health Care
items.summary: We cannot build affordable medical assurance on top of an unaffordable health care system. There is no evidence that MediAsas will halt future premium increase. The government must confront the more difficult issue of making health care itself affordable.
